versions.changelog:
- Added one-click automatic connection script (`chaoxing-mcp-auto.mjs`) for streamlined access, setup, status check, reauthorization, and background renewal.
- Major documentation update: new recommended workflow, step-by-step command usage, and detailed troubleshooting for fully automated or fine-grained manual operation.
- Migrated from two-script manual flow to unified intelligent script with local credentials file and browser-based setup (no secrets in conversation).
- Removed legacy skill-card.md documentation.
- Improved guidance on credential validation, error diagnosis, and system integration (including Windows scheduled tasks).
- All previous functions retained; new script handles all connection, renewal, validation, and error recovery automatically.
